name: Tidecoil Reef
blurb: A drowned kingdom of coral, currents and creatures that would like a word with your tail.

merchant.name: Coral
merchant.line: Every snake needs a friend. Mine bite, sting, glow or float, depending on your budget.

challenger.name: Captain Brine
challenger.line: Arr. Three trials. One week. Bring snacks. Arr.

banker.name: Clamsworth
banker.line: I keep your Pearls in my mouth. It's very secure. Please don't ask about hygiene.

boss.name: Leviathorn
boss.taunt: The sea forgets everything. It will forget you first.

levels.name: Shallow Lagoon
levels.text: Currents push the whole snake sideways now and then. Reach 5,000.

levels.name: Kelp Corridors
levels.text: Slick sand: you slide straight across it and can't turn. Eat 20.

levels.name: Whirlpool Basin
levels.text: Whirlpools open where the water darkens. Survive a minute.

levels.name: Coral Spiral
levels.text: Three coral keys wait in the spiral. Then find the clam gate.

levels.name: Lair: The First Hunt
levels.text: Leviathorn surges through the arena. Outswim him until he tires.

levels.name: Jelly Bloom
levels.text: Jellyfish drift through everything, including walls. Eat 22.

levels.name: Piranha Narrows
levels.text: Piranhas chase anything that moves. Reach 8,000.

levels.name: Eel Grotto
levels.text: A rival eel hunts you through the grotto. Survive 75 seconds.

levels.name: Shipwreck Hold
levels.text: A hermit crab ran off with the captain's compass. Catch it four times.

levels.name: Lair: The Armored Duel
levels.text: Leviathorn's scales are coral-hard. Drain him and bite them loose.

levels.name: The Undertow
levels.text: The undertow drags you onward. Ride it 460 meters.

levels.name: Sunken Maze
levels.text: The Pearl of Tides lies in the drowned maze. Find it.

levels.name: Tidal Glyphs
levels.text: Six tide plates in order. Miss one and the sea washes them all clean.

levels.name: The Breathing Reef
levels.text: The reef walls breathe in and out. Reach 10,000.

levels.name: Lair: The Last Stand
levels.text: Leviathorn bares his heart. Tire him out and end the tide.
